'''Tyrlena Norvold''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], she was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] inside the [[Sobrik Spaceport]] where she managed the sales of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] upgrades.<ref name="TOR" />
